description: One year against a 3-5 year minimum, on an otherwise good stack.

expectations.rationale: Java, Git, SQL and REST work are all real, so this is not a weak candidate - but the band asks for three to five years and the resume states one. The experience assertion is that the dimension lands well below 50 and the status is BELOW_RANGE, and the overall band records that a shortfall of that size has to be visible in the headline number.
